derived_judgments.claim: Opaque compiler/prover subprocesses should normally appear to the Anneal core as explicit coarse-grained external effects rather than as falsely pure functions; the effect request and result must preserve every promise-relevant input, outcome, residual assumption, and publication fence.

A minimally sufficient Anneal split is likely an immutable/value-oriented planning and result-classification core plus a small explicit host-effect shell for environment preparation, external tool/plugin execution, cancellation, and publication; this is a conditional design judgment, not adopted policy.
